name: BLOX
description: A macro neural architecture search benchmark and associated algorithms that define search spaces and evaluation protocols for comparing macro NAS methods.
reputation: Recognized within the NAS research community as a macro NAS benchmark and evaluation protocol, though adoption is more limited than some surrogate NAS benchmarks and it remains primarily used by NAS researchers.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; computationally expensive to run full evaluations; subject to search-space and training-protocol biases common in NAS benchmarks; intended for research on macro architecture search and comparison of NAS algorithms.
